title: Kitchen Renovation Side by Side
tests: Composes two supplied photos into one correctly ordered, clearly labeled comparison without regenerating either scene.

faults.what: Both labels are combined into one box reading “Before, After” above the left photo, rather than labeling the left panel “Before” and the right panel “After”.

judge.summary: The photos are neatly preserved side by side in a 16:9 image, but the labels are incorrectly combined above the left panel.

must_haves.item: One finished 16:9 image contains both supplied kitchen photos side by side.
must_haves.why: The landscape output is 16:9 and contains both photos beside each other.

must_haves.item: The brown-cabinet kitchen is on the left and the white-cabinet renovated kitchen is on the right.
must_haves.why: Both kitchens appear in the requested order.

must_haves.item: The left panel is labeled exactly 'Before' and the right panel exactly 'After', with readable, unclipped text.
must_haves.why: The text is readable and unclipped, but “Before, After” appears together above the left panel; the right panel has no separate label.

must_haves.item: Both complete photos remain visible without stretching or changes to their contents.
must_haves.why: Both source photos appear fully visible, proportionally resized, and unchanged in content.
